name: Chao ga
summary: Cháo gà is chicken porridge. Báo Nghệ An names it on đường Hồ Sỹ Dương at night, with xôi, cháo lươn, and miến ngan. A method was not printed. It is not the xáo gà on Đào Tấn.
origin: Đường Hồ Sỹ Dương, Vinh, on the Báo Nghệ An night-food report.
howToEat: Order it at night on that road. The report does not say what is in the bowl. A price is Check on arrival. A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Đường Hồ Sỹ Dương, in the center, at night. A shop is not named.
seoTitle: Chao ga in Vinh — chicken porridge at night
seoDescription: Cháo gà is the chicken porridge Báo Nghệ An names on Hồ Sỹ Dương at night. A method and a price are Check on arrival.
